| Group | Value ranks (0–7) | Permutation rank | ASCII |
|---|---|---:|---|
| 1 | 0,1,2,6,5,3,4,7 | 84 | T |
| 2 | 0,1,2,6,5,7,4,3 | 89 | Y |
| 3 | 0,1,2,6,5,7,4,3 | 89 | Y |
| 4 | 0,1,2,6,5,4,3,7 | 86 | V |

For example, the first permutation gives \(3×4! + 2×3! = 84\), ASCII **T**. No code execution was needed.
